whenToUse: Right after finishing something hard to undo, such as a payment, order, sign-up, or booking.
People want to recheck a number or amount.
The next thing to do is set.
whenNotToUse: Light results such as saving (use a toast).
People keep working on the same screen (use an inline confirmation message).
You'd bury the result under ads and recommendations.

alternatives.reason: Reporting a result without changing screens.
